name: Line Item
definition: Unit of information  showing the related  provision of products and/or services and monetary summations reported as a discrete line item.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Monetary value of the line amount total being reported for this settlement.

MeasureDateTimeStart.name: Measure Date Time Start
MeasureDateTimeStart.definition: Date/time on which the clock time measure started for a line item.

MeasureDateTimeEnd.name: Measure Date Time End
MeasureDateTimeEnd.definition: Date/time on which the clock time measure ended for a line item.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Total amount resulting from the gross amount plus freight charges, tax and plus/minus Adjustments.

DeliveryDateTime.name: Delivery Date Time
DeliveryDateTime.definition: Actual delivery date/time of the products and/or services for this line item.

FinancialAdjustment.name: Financial Adjustment
FinancialAdjustment.definition: Modification on the value of goods and / or services taking into account discounts, allowances and charges.

LogisticsCharge.name: Logistics Charge
LogisticsCharge.definition: Logistics service charge for this line item.

InvoicedProduct.name: Invoiced Product
InvoicedProduct.definition: Specifies the product and the quantity for which an invoice is generated.

NetWeight.name: Net Weight
NetWeight.definition: Net weight of the physical item which is invoiced.

BilledQuantity.name: Billed Quantity
BilledQuantity.definition: Quantity billed for this line item.

ChargeFreeQuantity.name: Charge Free Quantity
ChargeFreeQuantity.definition: Quantity that is free of charge for this line item.

MeasureQuantityStartRelatedLineItem.name: Measure Quantity Start Related Line Item
MeasureQuantityStartRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a measure quantity end is specified.

MeasureQuantityEndRelatedLineItem.name: Measure Quantity End Related Line Item
MeasureQuantityEndRelatedLineItem.definition: Line item for which a measure quantity end is specified.

Invoice.name: Invoice
Invoice.definition: Specifies the invoice in which the line item is included.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Charges specified for this line item.

NetPriceCharge.name: Net Price Charge
NetPriceCharge.definition: Allowance or charge applied to the net price. When the charge amount is added (credit)

GrossPriceQuantity.name: Gross Price Quantity
GrossPriceQuantity.definition: Quantity and conversion factor on which the gross price is based for this line item product and/or service.

NetPriceQuantity.name: Net Price Quantity
NetPriceQuantity.definition: Quantity and conversion factor on which the net price is based for this line item product and/or service.

GrossWeight.name: Gross Weight
GrossWeight.definition: Gross weight of the physical item which is invoiced.
